job: Show a small picture of a record, such as a video's poster frame, cropped to a fixed shape.
purpose: A box at a fixed ratio that crops its picture to fill it (object-fit: cover) and shows a centred stand-in icon while there is no picture. Sizes are heights: row fits a table or list row without growing it, the default is a little larger, fill takes its container's width. An optional mono label sits in the corner. When the picture fails to load, the script shows the stand-in instead of the browser's broken mark.
useWhen: A row or a card stands for something with a picture: a run's screen recording, a document's first page, a product image.
Rows of a table or a list each carry a small preview, with a duration or a count in the corner.
A card's head shows the picture at the full width of the card.

avoidWhen.when: A screenshot in the docs with a caption and a zoom.
A picture that belongs to a section of a public website.
A logo, a glyph or one or two letters in a square.

states.name: empty
states.how: no fd-thumb-img: the quiet fill and the stand-in icon (<i data-icon>)

states.name: failed
states.how: data-state="failed", written by fire/js/content.js when the picture does not load; the stand-in shows

variants.useWhen: A 21:9 strip, as fd-doc-frame and fd-site-media mean by wide. Without data-ratio the box is 16:9.
A 4:3 picture: a photo or a document page seen across.
A 1:1 picture: a product image or an album of results.
A 9:16 picture: a phone recording or a vertical video.
In a table cell or a list row: the row height less a little above and below, so the row does not grow.
The full width of its container, as the head of a card.

parts.role: The box that holds the ratio, the fill and the stand-in icon.
The picture, cropped to fill; it carries width, height and alt.
An optional corner label in mono: a duration or a count.
